===Pronunciation===

* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-mindset.wav|a=Southern England}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# A way of [[thinking]]; an [[attitude]] or [[opinion]], especially a [[habitual]] one.
#: {{ux|en|Earth Day is a way of propagating and celebrating the environmentalist '''mindset'''.}}
#* {{RQ:en:CNN|author=Kristen Rogers|title=Mindful eating could change your food habits and overall life. Here’s how to start|url=https://www.cnn.com/2021/10/14/health/mindful-eating-techniques-tips-wellness/index.html|date=2021-10-14|passage=These behaviors and '''mindsets''' contrast with mindful eating, which means using all your physical and emotional senses to experience and enjoy the food choices you make without judgment, said Lilian Cheung, a lecturer and director of health promotion and communication in the nutrition department at Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health, via email. {{...}} Once you have been mindfully eating for a while, the '''mindset''' can apply to other areas of your life.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220912234307/https://www.cnn.com/2021/10/14/health/mindful-eating-techniques-tips-wellness/index.html|archivedate=12 September 2022}}
